comments.text: Um... The Eve-O one is bullshit. You're not breaking any laws by straying off the beaten path. All you're doing is forgoing the protection of CONCORD. That's it. And since CONCORD is only effective in High-sec (0.7+) and Mid-sec (0.6-0.5) space? The moment you venture into Low-sec (0.4-), CONCORD doesn't protect you from aggressive players. And you're not immediately flagged and trackable in Low-sec, most of the time it's just gate-campers popping you the moment your jump-cloak fades.
